start.text: Detective. I was told to expect someone. I confess I find this intrusion rather trying. My husband is barely cold.

choices.text: I'll be brief. Tell me about Thursday night.
I understand your grief. I need to ask about Harlow's visit.
Your husband's watch — it was found some distance from the body.
I have nothing more to ask at present.

thursday_night.text: I retired early. Edmund was in his study — he often worked late. I heard nothing until the morning, when Mrs. Pemberton found him.

choices.text: Did you hear any visitors arrive?

no_visitors.text: None that I was aware of. The house was quite. Edmund had given the staff the evening off.

unusual_thursday.text: Edmund was particular about his privacy when conducting business. It was not so unusual.

business_deflect.text: Estate matters. I did not involve myself in the particulars. That is what one retains a solicitor for.

choices.text: Speaking of which — Harlow visited that evening.
The estate — how does it pass now?

estate_pass.text: To me, in trust. As it was always arranged. Edmund was meticulous about such things.

inheritance_pressure.text: You are implying something, Detective. I would choose your next words with care.

choices.text: I imply nothing. Ask about Harlow.
I am simply establishing the facts.

harlow_visit.text: Mr. Harlow is our family solicitor. He visits regularly on matters of business. If he was here that evening it would have been entirely routine.

choices.text: The staff were dismissed that night.

harlow_denied.text: I told you — I retired early. If Harlow came, he would have seen Edmund privately. That was their arrangement.

choices.text: Thank you. I have no more questions.

harlow_private_meeting.text: As I said, Edmund preferred privacy for business matters. Harlow's visit would have been expected.

expected_press.text: By Edmund. By Harlow. I really do not see what you are driving at, Detective.

choices.text: I think you do. But I won't press it further today.
One last question about the watch.

arrangement_press.text: I meant only that they had a regular professional relationship. Now I must insist we conclude this.

choices.text: Of course. I'll see myself out.

the_watch.text: Edmund's pocket watch? It was a gift — from me, on our tenth anniversary. The engraving was my idea.

choices.text: It was found away from the body. Any idea how?

watch_acknowledge.text: Yes. We were... quite happy once.

choices.text: I'm sorry for your loss. I'll leave you in peace.

watch_location.text: I have no idea. He may have dropped it. He was clumsy in his cups.

drinking_press.text: Edmund had a habit. I am not proud of it. But it is hardly relevant to your investigation.

choices.text: It may be more relevant than you think.
Understood. Thank you for your time.

marriage_press.text: I am recently widowed, Detective. I would appreciate a degree of sensitivity.

pemberton_deflect.text: She is loyal. She has been with us a long time. I'm sure she is simply shaken.

lady_composed.text: I think that is quite enough, Detective. I will be speaking to my solicitor about this intrusion.

end_polite.text: Good day, Detective. I trust this matter will be resolved with appropriate discretion.
